title: This Data Center Stock Is Surging on a Hyperscaler Deal. It’s a Signal of AI Demand.
summary: Cipher Digital rose sharply Wednesday after the data-center operator announced a new 15-year lease with a hyperscaler at one of its facilities—yet another sign of robust demand for artificial-intelligence capacity.
